parts.t: Downtown New Westminster is experiencing a remarkable renaissance. BC's original capital city is once again a destination — with its heritage architecture, vibrant waterfront Quay, and growing food and arts scene drawing new residents. Condos, lofts, and character conversions offer a range of options in one of the Lower Mainland's most historically rich neighbourhoods
